name: – § 5 – Am 23
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: 5. Calls on the Commission, once again, to immediately activate the PDCA’s democratic termination clause under Article 85(3)(b) of the agreement; emphasises that the failure to suspend the PDCA implies that the EU is flagrantly and consciously violating a legal clause contained in one of its agreements; calls for the immediate and unconditional release of the close to 1 300 political prisoners, and authorisation for Cubans forced to take the painful path of exile to return without reprisals; insists that the EU should proceed without further delay to suspend the PDCA, which has been systematically breached by the Cuban regime;
